'''Wulf Steinmann''' (12 July 1930 – 3 January 2019) was a [[German people|German]] physicist and former president of [[LMU Munich]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.pro-physik.de/details/articlePdf/1106605/issue.html|title=Physik Journal 4 (2005) Nr. 6, S. 26|date=2005|work=WILEY-VCH Verlag GmbH & Co. KGaA, Weinheim|language=German|access-date=2019-01-14|archive-date=2018-08-16|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180816220924/http://www.pro-physik.de/details/articlePdf/1106605/issue.html|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://trauer.sueddeutsche.de/traueranzeige/wulf-steinmann|title=Traueranzeige Wulf Steinmann|date=12 January 2019|work=SZ Gedenken|language=German}}</ref>
